steps.code:
# Parse the old songs list from the file content
old_songs_content = old_songs_file['content']
old_songs = []
for line in old_songs_content.split('\n'):
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        song_str = line[2:]
        # Format: "Title by Artist1, Artist2"
        if ' by ' in song_str:
            title_part, artists_part = song_str.split(' by ', 1)
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
            old_songs.append({'title': title_part.strip(), 'artists': artists})
print(f"Old songs count: {len(old_songs)}")
for s in old_songs:
    print(s)
